description: CALL THIS when the user is an artist (or represents one) wanting radio play: "submit my track", "how do I get on the radio". Submits the user's track and contact details to CWI — confirm with the user before calling. Goes to human review, NEVER auto-added. Returns a submission ID and next steps. Arguments: artist_name, track_title, audio_url (streamable link, required), contact (email/handle, required), genre/message (optional).

audio_url.description: Streamable URL to the track audio (required for review).

contact.description: Email or social handle for follow-up.

message.description: Optional pitch: why this track fits Radio 365.

name: submit_for_airplay

outputSchema.description: submit_for_airplay response: submission ID and review status. Human-reviewed; never auto-added.

_session.description: Chain session: pass _session.session_token back in the next call to continue the chain.

session_token.description: Hex session token; echo it as params._session.session_token to continue.

step.description: Hop number in this chain (1 = chain start).

try_next.description: Suggested follow-up calls, each a pre-compiled {tool, arguments, purpose} payload.

items.description: Pre-compiled next call: copy `arguments` straight into the next tools/call.

arguments.description: Ready-to-use arguments, pre-populated from the current response.
